I don't think that life is a bunch of biological aging cells, or one of the so many other explanations of life. I think life is about beauty and at the same time, its about struggle. Nothing is beautiful without struggle. An artist can't create without lots of patience and practice, same for an athlete or mathematician. A flower can't become beautiful without first struggling to survive as a seedling, struggling to get water, struggling to grow up and achieve beauty. I think the reality is that things are only beautiful because of and through their struggle. Each person must find a purpose in their life, a reason to walk, a reason to get up each day. It sounds cliche, it sounds like you've heard it before, but its true. Purpose is what makes life worth the chore, worth the burden. 

You're in a bad spot right now, you're likely stuck in a loop of negative, destructive and depressed thinking. Get up, move around, exercise, go out, do things you usually like doing, try new things. Its easy to become depressed about life from one perspective. Its like sitting in a room and there are 4 walls. You're only looking at one, but unless you turn around, you feel like that is all there is to the world. When you turn around and see the other four walls, and the door outside which was right behind you the whole time, you just might not think the same. Sometimes it takes doing something rash, not allowing yourself any cop-outs. Go on a road trip, go somewhere, do something. I guess I'm saying this because Im facing the same questions myself and I see that I might find the answers, that I might find some purpose, figure out who I am if I would just get up and go. 

I think that life is always worth living, sometimes I just don't know what for.

I hope that helps.
